id.description: A lowercase id: letters, digits and hyphens.

levelText.description: A stretch prompt: a line under a ### <level id> heading.

observable.description: One Look for bullet, on a card, an exercise or a script. The same grammar everywhere.

level.description: A level id from ladder.md, taken from the ### heading the bullet sits under.

pin.description: From a trailing {#id}. Keeps evidence attached through a reorder.

competencies.description: From trailing #tags. Absent means the file's default, then the pool's.

fallback.description: Nested '- Fallback:' line. 'hide' lowers to false: the row drops out while the fallback is on.

details.description: Any other nested 'Label: text' line, shown as written (Why, Good answer).
